texts:
The Ironclad’s strength surges!

The flames of the Demonic pact course through his blood. Cuts and bruises heal rapidly. The Valleyguard are cleaved in two, the Desert Tribe are burned to a crisp, Wind Walkers smashed into the ground, and even a familiar horde of aggressive bronze-cladded warriors are set ablaze with these exciting new flames!

All of the Ironclad’s enemies are shown no mercy. All of the Ironclads... Ironclad?
...where is everyone?
Unlocked relics: Red Skull, 纸蛙, and 损毁头盔.
